requirements.text: The contributor should see lint cover active Haskell sources, a malformed source rejected by the real command, duplicate Cabal dependencies removed, and the same public exports and command names after the change.

source-inventory-at-intake.text: The inventory maps the library, fifteen executables, and three test suites to their Cabal source directories. Naming's direct GHC test and drift sources are considered separately. The final review will explain any source directory deliberately excluded from lint.

evidence-limit.text: The original root build gate builds documentation and model packages, while selected registry jobs build off-chain targets. The new CI carrier builds the classified supported components used by required workflows and shipped commands, plus the library and tests. Its inventory must name every unbuilt declaration, and a green result is not a package-wide build claim.

candidate-boundary-and-epic-completion.text: The current candidate inventories 69 Haskell files. Fourmolu checks 67 because two independent verifier files must keep their intake bytes. HLint checks 41 files in nine directories; thirteen directories carry 214 measured hints in the current source state. Earlier intake measurement found 218 hints. These are separate extents and the excluded sources do not count as passing. Final epic integration issue 278 must close these gaps and cover all other repository code before the epic claims complete lint and formatting. The first complete component build exposed a pre-existing connected verifier compile error. Issue 282 owns that repair; the executable stays declared and unverified in this ticket.
